description: parse_rfc5322_headers matches Subject: and subject: by exact prefix but misses all other capitalizations (SUBJECT:, sUbJeCt:, etc.). RFC 5322 header names are case-insensitive. Tests using non-standard header capitalization will silently miss subject, message-id, and address fields, producing false-passing tests whose failures are invisible.
title: parse_rfc5322_headers uses case-sensitive header name matching
